title: Tall white in an Orcas pub asks what it's like to live on Earth
summary: Brent tells of Tall white in an Orcas pub asks what it's like to live on Earth, about "a number of years ago" at pub on Orcas Island, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
plain: A guest named Brent says a friend of his on Orcas Island told him about a strange meeting in a pub there some years ago. According to the friend, one of the Tall Whites, tall pale beings some people say live among us, asked him what it was like to live here, and when the friend assumed he meant the island, the being said, "No, on Earth." If true, it would mean these beings mix quietly with ordinary people.
